climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: An AVA on North Bass Island, an island in Lake Erie in Ohio, inside the Lake Erie AVA. The island is owned by Meier's Wine Cellars, and historically over half of it was used to grow grapevines.
